data_kind_note: Station measurements. QCF is homogenized by NOAA (PHA); QCU is the reported value after quality control only.

variables.name_en: Station monthly mean temperature (NOAA GHCNm v4, QCF adjusted)
variables.definition_zh: NOAA GHCNm v4 的測站月平均氣溫，QCF 版：通過品質管制，並用成對均一化演算法（PHA）修正測站遷移、儀器更換等造成的不連續。單位是攝氏度。
variables.note_zh: 實測參考，不是 NASA 資料。每個地點取距離 100 公里內、2001–2025 至少 240 個月有值的最近測站，存該站全部年份；測站不等於城市中心。缺月不補。
variables.data_kind_note: In situ station measurement; QCF has been homogenized (PHA adjustments applied) by NOAA, so it is not the raw reported value. QCF is the quality-controlled, pairwise-homogenized (PHA-adjusted) product; QCU is the quality-controlled but unadjusted product. The station is the nearest GHCNm station within 100 km with at least 240 months of data in 2001-2025, not the city centre.
variables.citation: Menne, M. J., C. N. Williams, B. E. Gleason, J. J. Rennie, and J. H. Lawrimore, 2018: The Global Historical Climatology Network Monthly Temperature Dataset, Version 4. J. Climate, in press, doi:10.1175/JCLI-D-18-0094.1. Data: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, GHCN-Monthly v4 (ghcnm.tavg.v4.0.1.20261113), https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/v4/, accessed 2026-11-14. Only monthly station values (derived selection) are used, for educational, non-commercial use; no endorsement by NOAA is implied.

variables.name_en: Station monthly mean temperature (NOAA GHCNm v4, QCU unadjusted)
variables.definition_zh: NOAA GHCNm v4 的測站月平均氣溫，QCU 版：只做品質管制、不做均一化調整，是測站原始回報的月值；品管不通過的月份不採用。單位是攝氏度。
variables.note_zh: 實測參考，不是 NASA 資料，與 ghcnm_tavg 用同一個測站。保留測站遷移與儀器更換造成的不連續。品管旗標非空白（E、D、R、K、W、I、L、O、S、T、M）的月份不採用。
variables.data_kind_note: In situ station measurement as reported (quality control only, no homogenization adjustment); months failing a QC check are excluded. QCF is the quality-controlled, pairwise-homogenized (PHA-adjusted) product; QCU is the quality-controlled but unadjusted product. The station is the nearest GHCNm station within 100 km with at least 240 months of data in 2001-2025, not the city centre.
variables.citation: Menne, M. J., C. N. Williams, B. E. Gleason, J. J. Rennie, and J. H. Lawrimore, 2018: The Global Historical Climatology Network Monthly Temperature Dataset, Version 4. J. Climate, in press, doi:10.1175/JCLI-D-18-0094.1. Data: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, GHCN-Monthly v4 (ghcnm.tavg.v4.0.1.20261113), https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/v4/, accessed 2026-11-14. Only monthly station values (derived selection) are used, for educational, non-commercial use; no endorsement by NOAA is implied.
